question: Which of the following cities hosted the first Climate Week in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Panama City**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The city of **Panama City**, the capital of **Panama**, has been selected to host the first **Climate Week** of the year in **May 2025**.
 
• This event is specifically designed as the **Latin America and the Caribbean Climate Week (LACCW) 2025**, aiming to mobilize regional climate action ahead of major global summits. ***Hence, the correct answer is Panama City.***
 
• The **May 2025** gathering serves as a strategic platform for **policymakers**, **local authorities**, and **private sector leaders** to discuss sustainable development and **decarbonization** strategies tailored to the **Latin American** context.
 
• Organized in collaboration with the **United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)**, the event focuses on identifying gaps and opportunities for **mitigation** and **adaptation** in the region.
